title: Claire’s Bay Scallops with Saffron and Leeks from The Hermit of Chappaquiddick
htmlIngredientLines: 2																		pounds genuine bay scallops (from Martha’s Vineyard or Nantucket)
1																		cup peeled, seeded, diced tomatoes (see note)
1/3																		cup crème fraiche or heavy cream
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
3/4																		cup dried bread crumbs (preferably brioche crumbs)
